Requirement:
How to fit a picture exactly to a single cell size in Aspose.Cells for .NET. Two approaches:

Approach 1 - Place picture over cells: use PictureCollection.Add(int row, int col, Stream) to add a floating picture, then set picture.Placement to PlacementType.MoveAndSize, and adjust picture dimensions (UpperLeftRow, UpperLeftColumn, LowerRightRow, LowerRightColumn) so the picture covers exactly one cell. For example set UpperLeftRow=5, UpperLeftColumn=2, LowerRightRow=6, LowerRightColumn=3 to fit cell C6.

Approach 2 - Place picture in cell: use Cell.EmbeddedImage property to embed an image directly inside a single cell. The image automatically sizes to fill the cell.
